summary: Skill is a thin Node.js wrapper around the sherpa-onnx offline TTS CLI. The wrapper resolves runtime/model dirs from env or flags, validates files exist, sets platform-appropriate library paths, and invokes the binary via spawnSync with an argv array (no shell). No prompt injection, exfiltration, persistence, or destructive ops detected. Only concern is install-time downloads from GitHub releases without checksum pinning, which is informational.

findings.detail: Downloads runtime binaries and model from GitHub releases without checksum/signature pinning.
